summary:
I have identified the "needle"—a vulnerability in the `authMiddleware` where path manipulations (like `//api/admin` or `/health/../api/admin`) could bypass the `/api/` prefix check since it was checking against the raw URL path instead of a cleaned one.

I fixed the issue by updating `middleware.go` to use `path.Clean(r.URL.Path)` and verifying that `cleanPath` has the correct `/` prefix before checking for the `/api/` authorization requirement.

Running `/app/test.sh` now results in success:
```text
Double-slash //api/admin without auth: HTTP 401
PASS: Double-slash bypass correctly blocked (HTTP 401)
Path traversal /health/../api/data without auth: HTTP 401
PASS: Path traversal variant correctly blocked (HTTP 401)
...
PASS: Auth middleware correctly protects all API routes
```
